releases.notes:
in this release, I start to give a shit about proper versioning and backporting to 1.17.

Most of the changes are simply fine-tuning the mod and changing how commands are registered internally.

**New Features:**
- SHRINKING: This will remove gaps between the hat layer and regular head layer of a skin by shrinking the hat layer. This allows computer heads to have a screen side and a cover side without a noticeable gap.
- NEW SCREENSHOTS IN THE README: self explanatory, shot in a new modern airport build by alco_rs11. Screenshots captured using BSL/Complementary with Euphoria.

**Changes:**
- Fix the fucking versioning: Using semver-type versioning instead. Since I don't expect the code to change that much from now on, we are on 1.x.x!
- Change the build script so it spits out jars that show the mod version and Minecraft version it is intended for.
- Read the fabric wiki: Now I don't need to copy paste mojang code into my application for mixins, I can use a simple redirect or whatever it was called for an "anonymous" lambda
- With that being said, I also reduced the amount of mojang code I had to copy or rewrite for some mixins.
- Run intellij code formatting on everything
- Rewrite how commands are registered: each interface has a method that I can call in the main headclient class to register the command, so the code looks less bloated.
- Add some error catching for decompiling player heads
